description: Golden commission cases for the Rust engine (authoritative) and the JS preview (docs/finance-design.md §3, §10). Rows follow the column lists; null means no value.
units: Money in integer fils (1 AED = 100 fils); rates in integer basis points (10000 = 100%); dates ISO YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Dubai).

rules.receivedShare: line * min(received, net) div net (0 when net = 0)

inputColumns: id feeBasis agreedValueFils feeRateBp fixedFeeFils partnerShareBp ownerHeld overrideBp agreementBp secondAgentShareBp secondAgentSource vatRegistered
outputColumns: id splitSource agentShareBp grossFils partnerFils netFils primaryFils secondFils companyFils vatFils

cases.G1: Sale, percentage fee, no partner, agreement 60%, VAT on
cases.G2: Rental, half-up fee, partner 50%, team default 50%, second agent 25% from the first agent, VAT off
cases.G3: G2 with the second agent taken from the company share
cases.G4: Fixed fee (rate ignored), Admin override 80% over agreement 70%, VAT on
cases.G7: Owner-held deal: no agent lines, the company keeps the whole net
cases.G10a: G2 with second agent 0% (first agent source)
cases.G10b: G2 with second agent 100% (first agent source)
cases.E1: Half-up at exactly .5 fils for the fee; floor for the agent line
cases.E2: Floor at .9999 fils: the agent line is 0 and the company keeps 1 fil

paymentColumns: id deal paymentsFils vatFils totalFils receivedFils primaryReceivedFils secondReceivedFils outstandingFils

paymentCases.G5: Payment of half the receivable on G1 (VAT on)
paymentCases.G9p: Zero-fee deal with nothing received: statement line 0

property.draws: Per case, in order, v = next(): feeBasis = v % 2 (0 percentage, 1 fixed); agreedValueFils = v % 10000000000001; feeRateBp = v % 10001; fixedFeeFils = v % 10000000000001; partnerShareBp = v % 10001; ownerHeld = v % 4 == 0; agreementBp = v % 10001 (no override); hasSecond = v % 2 == 1; secondAgentShareBp = v % 10001 (null unless hasSecond); secondAgentSource = v % 2 (0 first_agent, 1 company); vatRegistered = v % 2 == 1; after calculating, receivedFils = v % (2 * netFils + 1).
property.invariants: grossFils = partnerFils + companyFils + primaryFils + secondFils; every value >= 0; deterministic; received shares sum to at most min(receivedFils, netFils).
